newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Quiet Russian MinFins dip but trend unclear.
newsitem.headline: Quiet Russian MinFins dip but trend unclear.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were quoted lower compared with late Monday but dealers said on Tuesday the decline was technical, as there was no clear trend on Brady bond markets.
"There are as many buyers as sellers, but there are not many of either. The decline is technical rather than something else as we are not seeing market-moving news," one dealer said.
Avtobank dealer Pavel Afanasyev said prices had been fluctuating just 0.10-0.15 points in early trading and then the market slowed down.

Dealers said Thursday's data on U.S. initial jobless claims for the latest week could liven up the market, which is sensitive to any news which would suggest a further rise in U.S. interest rates. This would push down MinFin prices.
